notes.title: September 2025 update
notes.notes: [p]Hi![/p][p]Haven’t posted any updates in a while since most of them were about the full version of the game, which hasn’t been released yet :D[/p][p][/p][p]This project is being developed in free time outside of work, so when a heavy crunch started at work, we had to pause Super Bio-Man’s development for half a year. Now the crunch is finally over, and we’re back to working productively on the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We finished work on the penultimate level of the first campaign—stuffed it full of variety—and then went back to the demo levels and updated them.[/p][p][/p][p]Now the game runs small skill checks to make sure the player has grasped the basic mechanics: you can no longer skip the dash tutorial, and you’ll have to hit an electric transformer at least once to learn that the blue current doesn’t hurt you.[/p][p][/p][p]We also updated the visuals a bit—added electric fences, turbines on platforms, repainted the park in darker tones so that monsters stand out more. Enemy waves were slightly adjusted to fit the story better. Some character icons in dialogues were redrawn.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, about the “full” version.[/p][p]If the first level can be completed in about 7.5 minutes, and the second in 11, then I run through the third in as much as 14. It’s packed with tons of new stuff for maximum variety: buildings collapse, the world floods, the plot thickens, allies crush enemies, enemies turn out to be allies, allies become enemies, enemies of friends’ enemies turn into brothers, grandfathers of sisters’ fathers become friends, and so on.[/p][p]For this, we had to update the scripting system to more flexibly configure enemy waves and tasks. Two new guns were added, a multi-phase boss, and enemy abilities were expanded (which in turn created new gameplay situations).[/p][p][/p][p]We’re still recording the soundtracks with “vocals” ourselves for every new level. Specifically for the second chapter, we prepared a killer track with throat singing.[/p][p]“Vocals” in quotes because I can’t really sing, but I try hard, and then our composer works magic with autotune, compressors, equalizers, and other effects. The main thing is—the result is bom-bas-tic! :)[/p][p][/p][p]On Saturday, September 13, 2025, we’ll bring the latest version of the game to Saint Petersburg for the KONFA event, which will be held from 12:00 at 18 Bolshaya Morskaya Street. If you’re around—come hang out, play, and take pictures.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s how we currently see the plans for the future:[/p][list][*][p]Finish the first story chapter[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Add a couple more arcade levels[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Release in Early Access. Yes, this will most likely negatively affect sales, but our goal is not to make all the money in the world, but to create a great game that will still be fun to play in a year, or even five[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Make the next story chapter and not release it until it’s fully ready, but as consolation content we’ll create new arcade levels with content from the second chapter (new monsters, environments, arsenal, etc.)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Watch your playthrough videos, read reviews, fix bugs, move forward[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Repeat the same with the third chapter[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Campaign Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Watching your letsplays, reading your responses made me rethink the way how the combat arenas should be designed. So, I took a logical path and for the first time played through Serious Sam 1 and its expansion and without cheats. This made me think even more about gameplay improvements and overall fun factor...

So, the second campaign level was developed as an answer to all the criticizm we've received for the janky arcade GREEN OVEREXTERMINATOR level and kind of dragging GREEN INVASION level. I tried making combat encounters more balanced and varied and then added some platforming sections.

Enemy AI was improved a bit for the second level, and backported to the previous levels.

I've added a level selection menu, improved some "tutorial" sections in hope of better explaining the core gameplay mechanics (I still don't want to stop the game and show a picture like "here is your full manual" - instead, I've tweaked some objects' positions to let the players perform needed actions as if they came up with them themselves). So, the first campaign level should be more friendly and less boring to the new players.

Oh, yes, I've added a new achievement too.

So, please, play our game, tell your friends about it and have a good time :)
(and don't forget to comment on our new content - we are working to make this game as good as possible)

notes.title: Checkpoint Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44514340/8fc9023a6056b403d658e0d41e59739869f4c9cf.png[/img]

Hello!

We have improved a bunch of things, rebalanced some AI and combat stuff, but most importantly: added an ability to load the campaign from the nearest checkpoint without restarting level.

So, if you don't want to learn gameplay mechanics, or unable to perform well, you can finally tank through all the obstacles and see the victory screen :)

Most of my time was taken by implementing and polishing new stuff for the second level of the first campaign. Our artist has almost finished drawing content for the third chapter of the game.

notes.title: Demo Version Update for FPS Festival
notes.notes:
Hello!

Here's what's new in the demo:
[list]
[*] Repainted the crates with medkits.
[*] Added a healthbar for the boss. Now you can finally see how much damage you're dealing :)
[*] Added few more medkits to the Green Invasion level 1.
[*] UFOs during Green Invasion now start spawning only after you pick up the Statgun.
[*] Changed in-game text during clearing of the Undergrounds. Now, instead of "50% of aliens killed" there are button prompts hinting on new game mechanics (Press F for quick attack and press Q for quick weapon switch).
[/list]

notes.title: Demo version update - 03.17.24
notes.notes:
Hello!
Here's our new update!

What's new:
* Added an ability to quickly grab runners without switching to fists by pressing F.

What's fixed:
* Decreased damage received by the player from their own rockets.
* Improved some dialog texts.
* Fixed a critical bug occuring when returning to the main menu while the dialog window was open.

[previewyoutube=pEUy_cTWUwY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo version update 03.10.24
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've added a weapon-selection wheel.
You can bring it up by holding Q or R1, then select a weapon icon with your mouse or right stick.
Time slows down while the wheel is open.
Quick switching to the last used weapon still works - by just tapping Q or R1.

[previewyoutube=BZo6MjXDpn0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo version update 03.03.2024
notes.notes:
Hello! We've been kind of quiet, but kept working on the game.

This time we are bringing these changes:
* Added Sound volume sliders! Now you can mute the game without alt-tabbing :)
* Added a Frame Limiter to the Video Options, so you could lock the game at 60 FPS even if your monitor is capable of refreshing 240 times per second (to drop some load off your GPU).
* All highlighted options are now flippable with left-right buttons.
* Added a Campaign Selection screen with a glimpse of upcoming chapters.
* Added a Challenge Selection screen with a new challenge - ACID SPEEDRUN.
* Added new challenges - 3 for ACID SPEEDRUN and 1 for the GREEN INVASION.
* Added a tiny animation to crosshair after each shot.

Keyboard and Language options are still locked, but I'll get to them eventually.

notes.title: Demo version update 02.15.24
notes.notes:
Hello!
After fixing critical bugs and releasing the second game mode it's time for quality-of-life improvements!

I've unlocked V-Sync and Screen Resolution buttons in the Video menu.
The game defaults to your current screen resolution and then lets you quickly change it.
V-Sync is on by default, but now you can turn it off.

Also cut and shuffled some dialog lines in the Campaign mode in order to make them more engaging.

Did you manage to find all Super Bio-Boys yet? :)

notes.title: Demo version update 02.14.24
notes.notes:
Hello!
The Steam Festival has passed, but we are still publishing major updates!

This time we brought a new playable story mode (with a single level at the moment, though), added two more achievements for the secret-hunters and fixed some small bugs (like collisions with breakable objects whole dodging).

Please, tell us your thoughts about our story level and tell your friends about our game - this would help us immensely!

notes.title: Demo version update 02.11.24
notes.notes:
And here is our new update!

[list]
[*] As the users asked, I made the enemy rockets appear larger. Now they look more menacing and are much easier to spot.
[*] Rebalanced the STATGUN damage against the boss - it used to be waaay to easy to defeat her. With the unlimited magazine should come at least some disadvantages :)
[*] Added mouse sensitivity sliders and a vertical inversion toggle.
[*] Fixed some out-of-bounds-related bugs.
[*] Finished the core gameplay draft of the first story level. When I finalize the scripting part, I'll make it publically available.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo version update 02.10.24
notes.notes:
Another date, another update!

By request of our artist I've changed the main menu background rain from giblets to guns.

We've improved the UI for better gameplay experience:
* Made the healing effect more defined
* Improved the damage and low HP effects
* Added a [TAB] prompt
* Made a dynamic crosshair, which now changes its icon depending on the ammo counter values

We've fixed some bugs:
* Monster spawn queues are now properly cleared on level restart
* Probably fixed monsters' ability to push the protagonist through thin fences
* Fixed input system flags on level restart and pause
* Fixed some localization stuff

notes.title: Demo version even hotter fix 02.09.24
notes.notes:
Gameplay videos of our game finally started appearing on YT, which helped us finding new things, that we have overlooked.

* Fixed FOV slider's description.
* Fixed the level ending screen and added an ability to restart the level without returning to the main menu (such propmt appears after 3 seconds).
* Added UI scaling for screens wider than 16:9 (tested on 24:9 virtual aspect ratio).
* Added juicy giblets to the main menu's background.
* Fixed a critical bug in EXPLORER OVEREXTERMINATOR achievement's trigger. Now you really have to show me some skill to [b]achieve[/b] this achievement.
* Balanced weapon swapping for reload animation cancelling. Now it's possible to swap the gun only if it's not playing animations of drawing or firing. You can still swap while reloading (and this feature will persist).
* Added spawning of 10 more medkits at the central district at the beginning of the mega-wave.

notes.title: Demo version hotter fix 02.08.24
notes.notes:
Today was the day of scripting campaign levels.
But as players asked: I've added the FOV-slider.

Then found out that I accidentially broke time requirements for QUICK OVEREXTERMINATOR achievement. For some reason its timer was counting the real time instead of game time. This should work properly now.

Also found out a way to get stuck out of bounds, so added a teleport trigger for that case. If you try really hard - you could jump off the map and fall to your death... But at least you won't softlock the game! :)

notes.title: Demo version hotfix 02.06.24
notes.notes:
For some unknown reason I forgot to turn on boss's weakness to certain weapons (also rockets). Now each stage of the boss can be defeated with 5 well-placed rockets.

Also added markers, showing the way for the players.
